title: Electrolyte additives in Li-ion batteries: from mechanisms to application
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01310K, Review Article
Runze Zhang, Yinglei Wu, Guangfu Ge, Jinxuan Liu, Jihu Wang, Sirui Wang, Zhongyi He
This review categorizes lithium battery electrolyte additives by composition, chemical structure, function, and properties, highlighting their critical role in enhancing energy density, cycle life, and safety.
